job.title: Automatic Door Engineer
job.description:
Automatic Door Engineer

South East

OTE £65,000 +

An award-winning, global market leader in the automatic door industry is currently going through a period of sustained growth and is looking to expand its service engineering team and is, therefore, looking for an additional Engineer to join their team in the South East region. The roles offer an ongoing training package, with exciting prospects for personal growth and development. The package includes a basic salary of up to £41,000, £2400 per annum callout standby fee, 33 days holiday, a lucrative commission scheme as well as a first-time fix incentive.

As an Automatic Door Engineer, you will be responsible for:

· Servicing, maintaining, and repairing a wide range of automatic doors manufactured by companies such as Assa Abloy, Record, Geze, Dorma, Stanley, Tormax, Horton, Label, and more.

· Fault finding on electrical, mechanical, and electronic equipment.

· Electrical, mechanical, and hydraulic fault finding

· Basic salary up to £41,000 depending on experience.

· £2400 per annum callout standby fee

· £1200 London Weighting allowance depending on location

· Home-based, door to door pay

· Premium overtime rates after 8 hours per day, travel time is considered overtime

· All power tools and hand tools provided

· Brand new professionally racked company van with satnav

· Mobile phone

job.title: Automatic Door Installation Engineer
job.description:
Automatic Door Installation Engineer

Leeds
£18.00 per hour + overtime + door-to-door travel + performance bonus

Overview

An award-winning, national market leader in the automatic door industry is looking to expand its installation team.

Our client’s installation portfolio now includes everything from swing and sliding operators to curved doors and integrated speed lanes, giving experienced installation engineers the opportunity to work across a broader range of entrance technology.

The business is expanding its work with major UK retailers and is looking for another engineer to join its installation team.

The Role

You’ll take responsibility for installing entrance automation equipment across retail and commercial environments.

Projects include:

  • Automatic swing doors
  • Automatic sliding doors
  • Curved sliding systems
  • Integrated speed lanes

Most assignments are within approximately 60–90 minutes of the Engineers home address, although the wider territory can stretch from the Midlands through to the North East.

Because the company has several depots around the UK, engineers are generally able to return home each evening. Overnight stays are usually around one to three per month.

There is also night work available for engineers who want it, attracting time-and-a-half rates between 7:00pm and 7:00am.

About the Company

Our client is an established national entrance automation business supporting large multi-site customers across the UK.

Its contract base includes several major supermarket and high-street retailers, with further national contract wins supporting continued installation demand.

Candidate Profile

This opportunity is likely to suit an engineer already working within automatic doors who wants access to varied installation projects and substantial overtime.

You’ll need to be comfortable with travel, longer working weeks and occasional stays away.

Experience with multiple automatic-door systems would be beneficial, while flexibility around night installations could make you particularly valuable to the existing team.

The successful Automatic Door Installation Engineer will:

  • Be experienced working for an EN 16005 recognised automatic door company
  • Be experience installing a wide range of automatic door systems
  • Hold a valid EN 16005 certificate, or at least have held one in the past
  • Hold a CSCS Card
  • Have experience electrical and mechanical fault finding

In return, you will receive a remuneration package which includes:

  • Starting hourly rate of up to £18 per hour depending on experience
  • Pay review after probation and every twelve months
  • Home-based, door to door pay
  • Overtime at 1.5 paid between 7pm – 7am during the week and all hours worked on weekends
  • Overnight projects include company-booked accommodation plus meal, overnight and entertainment allowances totalling £75.
  • Efficiency bonus up to £500 per month. Expected efficiency bonus earnings around £4,000 annually
  • 33 days holiday – paid at average working week hours.
  • All power tools provided
  • Brand new professionally racked company van
  • Mobile phone
  • Tablet
  • Pension scheme
  • Exciting long term career prospects
  • Expected OTE of £60,000 +

Please note, if your application is suitable, one of our consultants will call you within 5 working days. If you have not heard from us within this time, your application has unfortunately been unsuccessful, however we will keep your details on our talent management system to consider you for future opportunities.

Reading

Engineers will be put through DHF Gate Diploma, DHF Door Diploma, and IPAF

job.title: Lead Field Engineer
job.description:
Lead Field Engineer
Stevenage
£55k + Bonus + Benefits

One of our key clients is seeking a motivated individual to step into a newly created, high-impact role within their team. Initially, the focus will be on training and development but will later move into a management role as the role progresses. The role is still hands on, therefore, will involve some time on the tools.

Following recent growth, the company has secured several national contracts and significantly expanded their team of Engineers, many of whom bring expertise in a single discipline—either automatic doors or industrial doors. The division covers automatic doors, industrial doors, gates, and barriers, offering a comprehensive service across these areas.

The company is committed to cross-training and is looking for someone who can support the development of single-discipline Engineers into well-rounded, multi-skilled professionals. This role will also involve helping less experienced Engineers reach full competency across multiple specialisations, ensuring a high standard of expertise across the team.

This position will require the Individual to take complete ownership of Engineer inductions and onboarding. A significant portion of your time will be dedicated to working closely with new hires during their first three months, familiarising them with company processes and products through hands-on training at the company training facility. As these Engineers become proficient in diverse disciplines, the role will gradually evolve to encompass more traditional management responsibilities.

This role requires a flexible and adaptable approach, as the company operates within a vast business framework, though the department itself is small. The ideal candidate should have a readiness to support other areas as needed, demonstrating a team-oriented, all-hands-on-deck mindset.

The position offers a starting salary of £55,000, along with an enticing benefits package. This role is ideal for a self-motivated individual who is passionate about developing talent and thrives in an environment of continuous learning and cross-functional support.

What’s on Offer?

  • A basic salary of £55,000
  • Door to door pay
  • Bonus scheme for late night working. Financial incentives post 12am and 1am
  • 33 days holiday
  • Internal training academy with the option to move to departments such as HVAC or passenger lifts
  • Annual bonus worth over £2,000
  • Fully stocked company van – with personal use permitted
  • Mobile phone
  • Pension scheme matched up to 6%
  • Corporate benefits package which includes: Discounted gym membership, discounted hotels, etc

If you have not heard from us within this time, your application has unfortunately been unsuccessful, however we will keep your details on our talent management system to consider you for future opportunities.
